name: Haus Bergheim
beschreibung:
=== beschreibung ===

Haus Bergheim is a hotel located in the Austrian state of Tirol. The accommodation is situated in a quiet location with a view of the surrounding mountains. The rooms are furnished with traditional materials and furniture. The hotel features a restaurant serving regional cuisine as well as a wellness area. Guests can go hiking in the summer and use nearby ski resorts in the winter. The hotel's service is focused on personal care. The surroundings offer a wide range of opportunities for nature experiences.
